body.html: A tissue box cover turns a changing cardboard carton into a calm object within the room. On a vanity, bedside table, meeting-room console or desk, it may be small but often sits directly in view. The 130 × 130 × 145 and 265 × 245 × 85 mm starting sizes describe very different proportions. The carton actually used determines which, if either, is suitable. A clear outline can settle quietly into the scheme, while leather colour, grain and a carefully placed dispensing aperture give the cover its own presence. The tissues should remain easy to reach; the outer case should support that simple gesture rather than make a performance of it.

Provide an original carton or dependable external and aperture dimensions for development. Internal size, dispensing opening and refill access must work as one. If suppliers may vary, compare the intended cartons; a custom cover is developed around the confirmed pack. Housekeeping or office management should use the sample to test inserting and removing the carton. Location, moisture and cleaning products also belong in the brief so finish and care can be discussed specifically. Branding will often remain a quiet detail. Fit matters most: when no edge presses against the pack and each tissue draws cleanly into place, the everyday gesture feels as effortless as the object appears.

If the property uses several tissue formats, assign each cover clearly to its carton and location. A consistent appearance is then supported by traceable project data rather than assumptions about interchangeability.

body.html: A few answers before our first conversation.

faq.q: Can you develop a custom shape or size?

a.html: Yes. We discuss custom dimensions and original designs for the selected accessory. A sketch, a photograph of the setting or dimensions of the objects to be accommodated help translate your idea into a reviewable specification.

faq.q: How do we agree the material and branding?

a.html: We discuss colour, finish and operating conditions. Material samples and artwork showing logo placement support the selection. Blind debossing, foil stamping and other methods depend on the material and accessory.

faq.q: What does SFP need for a quotation?

a.html: Tell us the accessory or idea, quantity needed, required date and main design preferences. One-offs and very small runs are welcome, and our offer also covers large projects. We agree the specification and timing around your needs. The project planner helps you bring the details together.

body.html: Choose an individual accessory as your starting point. Specify materials, dimensions and details separately for every item in your enquiry.

Tissue box covers conceal square or rectangular tissue cartons in guest rooms and bathrooms. The dispensing opening may be round, oval or rectangular, while an optional magnetic base can simplify replenishment. Two starting sizes, custom dimensions, PU or genuine leather, wood, padding, decorative stitching and branding allow the cover to be matched to the actual refill carton.

body.html: Production can take 4–6 weeks after your approval. We agree the specific delivery date with you.
Where the product, materials and capacity allow, express orders are available for a surcharge, with delivery potentially in under two weeks. We confirm feasibility before you place the order.
For new customers, we request 100% payment in advance. For large orders from existing customers, we request a 50% advance payment. The agreed terms are set out in your quotation.
